-B.help: Set the POCSAG baud rate: 512, 1200, or 2400 (default: 1200).

-F.help: Set the FLEX pager address/capcode (default: 1234567). Must be in the range 1 to 2097151.

-I.help: Generate POCSAG signal with inverted polarity. Use this to test the decoder's auto-detection of inverted signals.

-N.help: Use POCSAG numeric mode (function 0) instead of alphanumeric mode. Valid numeric characters: 0-9, space, hyphen (-), period (.), U.

-S.help: Generate waveforms that render readable text on the SDL_SCOPE display. Uses a 5x7 bitmap font.

-o.help: : CW: Set threshold for dit detection (default: 500)

-r.help: : (Deprecated) Repeatable mode is now always enabled.

-z.help: Generate ZVEI selective call tones for the given digit string.
